name: List the sign-in providers
description: The provider buttons the sign-in page draws, from [vars] auth_providers -- which a deployment keeps in step with the providers soma-pub-auth serves (github here, plus every [oauth2_login.providers.*] it merges). Served at /v1/auth-providers, a SIBLING of the sign-in routes: soma-pub-auth's oauth2_login captures every /v1/auth/{provider}, so a child path would be read as a provider slug. A ROUTE and not the SPA's own list, because which providers exist is the deployment's and moves with its config, not with a build. parse_json reads the var, a JSON array string, into `data.providers`; the body is that array, so an unconfigured provider never becomes a button that 404s. `metadata.vars` is read by parse_json's source against the whole context, which reaches it where a JSONLogic body could not.

tasks.name: Read the provider list from config
